verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's first-party docs cover the whole story. It schedules daily default backups, lets you create, schedule and restore backups for production and development branches, and supports manual backups on top. Restores are self-serve: you restore into a branch, including a point-in-time restore via `--restore-point`, and backup.succeeded/backup.failed webhooks make the schedule's results visible. Missing for 10: details on configuring backup frequency and retention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of backups and restores.
